annotations.title: Text to speech (paid, saves a file)

description: Turns text into speech with the Ezkielyna API and saves the audio file locally (never overwrites). Default model edge-tts with voice id-ID-GadisNeural (Indonesian). Max 4000 characters. Paid per input character; counts toward the session cap. Run list_audio_models for models, voices and prices.

filename.description: Optional file name (no folder). Existing files are never overwritten.

format.description: Audio format (default mp3). Some models only return MP3; the file extension follows the real audio type.

model.description: TTS model id (default edge-tts). See list_audio_models.

voice.description: Voice name for the model, e.g. id-ID-GadisNeural or id-ID-ArdiNeural (edge-tts), Kore (tts-gemini-3.1-flash). Empty = the model's default voice. Passed to the API as given.

name: text_to_speech
title: Teks ke suara / Text to speech
